title: Integrability of composed Gaussian bivariate stability
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mathcal A)$ be a measurable space with a finite measure $\mu$, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $\Phi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function. For $a,b\in\mathbb R$, define $B(\rho,a,b)$ as the probability that $U\le a$ and $\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}V\le b$, where $U,V$ are independent standard Gaussian variables. If $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ are measurable and take values in $[0,1]$, then $x\mapsto B(\rho,f(x),g(x))$ is integrable with respect to $\mu$.
